## !! DELEGATION CONSTRAINTS
**Currently allowed worker models (picker ids): `luna` (medium/high), `terra` (low/medium/high), `haiku` (medium), `haiku-api` (medium), `onyx`, `opus` (low/medium), `sonnet` (low/medium/high), `sol` (low/medium), `deepseek` (default), `composer`, `deepseek-or` (high), `haiku-work` (medium), `haiku-neozeit` (medium), `grok-low`, `grok-medium`, `grok-47-medium` (default), `terra-api` (low/medium), `luna-api` (low/medium/high), `composer-fast`, `gpt62-sol` (low).**
Anything else is off limits for delegation (except the escalation tier in DELEGATION.md), even if `quota pick` names it or an old note says it is fine.
A candidate with under 5% headroom in any usage window is also refused: pick the next option, don't argue with the number.
Down until reset: none. Source of truth: `~/.agents/picker/guards.json` (`allowedModels`); `quota pick` enforces it.
If David says usage is running low, or a window is burning faster than planned: stop, re-run `quota status` and `quota pick`, re-evaluate the task against the allowed list, and propose the cheapest adequate option before launching anything.

Static marketing site for Automatism (AI workflows for agencies), served by GitHub Pages at
`https://automatism.co.za`. Global rules in `~/.agents/AGENTS.md` apply too; this file adds what is
specific to this repo.

## Start here
- Automatism's state and work streams live in the hub repo `~/Projects/automatism-demo`: read its
  `docs/STATE.md` (`git -C ~/Projects/automatism-demo show main:docs/STATE.md`) before starting.
  Work in this repo is tracked there as its own stream.

## Rules
- **Pushing `main` publishes the live site.** Never push without David's OK.
- Plain HTML/CSS/JS, no framework and no build step. Keep it that way unless David decides otherwise.
- `live/` is build output of the demo app in `~/Projects/automatism-demo` (hashed Vite assets plus
  `live/recordings/*.json`). Never hand-edit `live/assets/*`; change the app there and rebuild. The
  copy recipe is in `~/Projects/automatism-demo/AGENTS.md` ("Updating the site's live/ copy").
- `live/index.html` points the app at `https://demo.automatism.co.za` (the demo backend).
- Keep `CNAME` and `.nojekyll`; Pages serves the files as they are.

## Check before calling it done
No tests or linters. PORTS.md lists no listener for this project; get a block in `~/.agents/PORTS.md`
before serving a local preview (never http.server's default 8000). Look at every page you changed at
phone width and desktop width.

## Stack and layout

Plain HTML, CSS and JS. No package.json, Makefile or README at the root, so no commands are listed here.

## Layout
| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `index.html`, `404.html`, `robots.txt` | Home page, not-found page, robots |
| `client-updates/`, `unbilled-time/` | Workflow demo pages with films |
| `live/` | Built live demo app (from automatism-demo) |
| `assets/` | Shared CSS, favicon and the film player |
| `media/` | Films (`.mp4`) and posters |
